name: skill-sync
description: Compare local skill bundles with a selected GitHub repository and apply only the exact transfer plan the user confirms.

interface.shortDescription: Compare local and GitHub skills before confirmed sync
interface.longDescription: Inventory complete local and GitHub skill bundles, distinguish missing, changed and unknown copies, prepare portable reviewable payloads, and upload or install only the exact plan the user confirms.
defaultPrompt: Compare my local skills with the GitHub repository I specify.
Show which skills differ on each side without transferring anything.
